label: sec:proton-gravity-tests-intro
html: The small residuals observed in electronic versus muonic spectroscopy probe how the local effective deformation parameter q_{\mathrm{local}} responds to the spatial Compton wavelength of the orbiting lepton. This section analyzes the electronic versus muonic proton charge-radius shift (r_p), formulates the entropic-gravity coupling from the substrate free-energy gradient, and proves the local substrate-q theorem unifying both shifts. Applied at an electroweak interaction vertex, the same theorem gives a zero-free-parameter shift of the W-boson mass, compared in seven diagnostic tables against the PDG 2024 world average and high-precision collider measurements.
